items.title: Binance founder CZ calls for wallet diversification after $70 million Coldcard exploit
items.snippet: Binance founder Changpeng Zhao says hardware wallets can still have bugs and suggests spreading funds across multiple wallets after the major Coldcard security failure.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs end July in the green despite late-month selling
items.snippet: Spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $172.4 million in July inflows but remained $5.3 billion negative year to date after heavy withdrawals in May and June.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC за ключовими словами.
